Sabanci University Scholarship Details

The Sabanci University Scholarship 2026 presents a fully funded award offer that covers the tuition, accommodation, travel, and a living stipend to support their other related study costs.

International students have the opportunity to gain admission scholarship at Sabancı University. Every international candidate, who applies to Sabanci University, is evaluated for a scholarship automatically when they fulfill the application requirements.

Almost all students admitted to Sabancı University’s academic graduate programs (except professional non-thesis graduate programs) are either totally or partially exempted from annual tuition fees.

Please note that your academic background, reference letters, exam results, transcripts, interview results and any document showing your academic success such as prizes in the competitions, any Olympiad certificates will be considered by the Scholarship Committee

Sabanci University Scholarship Benefits

Undergraduate Scholarships at Sabanci University include;

  • 25%-100% Tuition waiver

  • Accommodation

Graduate Sabanci University Scholarship Turkey:

  • The award will cover all the expenses to pursue a degree from Turkey under this scholarship.

  • Masters – 2,500 TL/10 months + Dormitory (room for double)(**) for 10 months

  • PhD – 3,000 TL/12 months + Dormitory (within the bounds of possibility single room, if occupied, room for double) for 12 months

  • Other benefits include; laptop, travel costs, medical-related costs

Available Programmes for Sabanci University Scholarship

Almost all academic fields and majors are available at Sabanci University for Bachelors, Masters and PhD Degree program.

Sabanci University Scholarship Requirements

To be eligible for the undergraduate and postgraduate Sabanci University Scholarship, applicants must satisfy the following conditions:

  • Applicants must be of foreign nationality and in good health.

  • Applicant’s academic qualifications and age requirements:

  • Applicants must demonstrate excellent academic performance

Required Documents for Sabanci University Scholarship Turkey

While applying for the 2026 Sabanci University Scholarship Turkey, you will be required to submit the following documents;

  • The copy of one of the exam/diploma result(s) with a valid score accepted by Sabancı University Applications

  •  If graduated, High School Diploma (if in another language rather than Turkish or English, notarized translation should also be submitted)

  • Official transcript, showing all courses and grades taken in the entire high school  education, approved by the high school authority.

  • Uploaded transcripts which are without wet signature and stamp or without e-signature, which can be verified online, will not be taken into consideration.

  •  If taken before, a language proficiency exam score accepted by Sabancı University

  • If available, an academic letter of recommendation letter

  • If the applicant had/continue to have secondary education in Turkey, below documents are required:

    • Residence Permit Copy for those with foreign nationality

    • Blue Card Copy or Official Letter for Renouncement from Turkish Nationality for those who renounced Turkish citizenship

    • Residence Permit Copy or an official document that shows the date of acquisition of Turkish citizenship (such as Vukuatlı Nüfus Kayıt Örneği or court decision) for those who acquire Turkish citizenship not by birth
